newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOCCER-NEW DATE FOR MOROCCO-ETHIOPIA GAME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NEW DATE FOR MOROCCO-ETHIOPIA GAME.

text.p: Morocco and Ethiopia will play their outstanding African Nations Cup qualifying match in Casablanca on June 1, the Confederation of African Football (CAF) said on Monday.
The match was originally scheduled for January 26, but postponed after 16 Ethiopian players defected in Rome while travelling from Ethiopia.
It was the second time the Ethiopian team had suffered a mass defection while travelling through Italy on their way to matches in Morocco.
Ethiopia, who had considered withdrawing from the competition, had decided to continue playing their qualifiers, the CAF said in a statement.
The Ethiopians have played two other qualifying matches, drawing one and losing the other. Morocco have drawn both their opening two qualifying matches.
Senegal lead the group with four points while Egypt are second, one point adrift.
The top two teams qualify for the finals in Burkina Faso next February.
